product_metadata.title: MISSLO 30 Large Pockets Dual Sided Hanging Shoe Organizer for Closet with Rotating Hanger Hanging Shoe Shelves, Grey
features: 【Dual sides roomy pockets】This hanging shoe rack has 30 pockets in total, can holds kinds of shoes like sandals slippers, tennis shoes, sneakers, it is the perfect item to transform your closet into an amazing storage area for your shoes;

【Large and sturdy mesh pockets】This closet shoe organizer work great for ladies size 8.5-9 shoes, a size 13 men's shoes, roomy enough to put two sandals or slippers in each pocket，also suit for bra, socks, underwears, folded clothes, jeggings, scarves;
【360 degree rotating hanger】The hanger can be rotated in any direction you want, besides being able to hang this from a conventional closet rod, also can hang them from a wire shelving rod, locker;

【Perfect length for various closets】The whole dimension of the hanging shoe shelves is 48.8 "L * 16.9"W, so very suit for most closets in your home, such as bedroom, laundry room, play room, college dorm rooms, cleaning closet, baby or kid rooms;

【Takes up minimal space】This hanging closet organizer not only can save floor and shoe shelf space, but also can keep your shoes where they aren't going to end up scattered or piled on top of each other.
